items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Rudy Van Gelder's studio and recording sessions but does not mention a direct personal interaction or relationship with Van Gelder himself, only with the musicians who recorded there.

ctx.x: There was a thing where this guy had a studio in New Jersey. It was . . .

He had a studio over there. Every Sunday – actually, the studio was at his mother’s living room. They made – he made a studio in his mother’s living room. That’s how he started. They used to go over there every Saturday and make records, anybody. Mostly they used Miles’s band. They used Paul and Joe and Red and Trane. So Trane used to make – bring people over every week, and they’d make a different record. When Joe couldn’t make it, they used alternate people. They had alternate person to go, each instrument. So…
